description: Imitation of the World Bank Atlas of Sustainable Development Goals 2023 chart 'Tuberculosis detection rates plummeted during the pandemic' (https://datatopics.worldbank.org/sdgatlas). Data: World Health Organization, retrieved from World Development Indicators (SH.TBS.DTEC.ZS). Hovering the line chart updates the bar chart to show that year's detection rates. Written directly in Vega (not Vega-Lite) so tracked signals (label, selectRegion) are backed by real signal values rather than Vega-Lite's internal `_store` datasets, which reVISit's replay mechanism cannot repopulate. revisitAnswer rides on the existing line-hover interaction (responseId "line-value-hover", with no matching "response" entry in config.json) purely so reVISit's own signal-driven validity check has something to be satisfied by.

tooltip.signal: hoverYearIdx < 0 ? null : {'Year': label, 'Europe & Central Asia': data('years')[hoverYearIdx].ECS, 'Middle East & North Africa': data('years')[hoverYearIdx].MEA, 'North America': data('years')[hoverYearIdx].NAC, 'Latin America & Caribbean': data('years')[hoverYearIdx].LCN, 'South Asia': data('years')[hoverYearIdx].SAS, 'Sub-Saharan Africa': data('years')[hoverYearIdx].SSF, 'East Asia & Pacific': data('years')[hoverYearIdx].EAS}

on.update: hoverYearIdx < 0 ? tooltip : (tooltip && tooltip.Year === hoverYearLive ? tooltip : ({'Year': hoverYearLive, 'Europe & Central Asia': data('years')[hoverYearIdx].ECS, 'Middle East & North Africa': data('years')[hoverYearIdx].MEA, 'North America': data('years')[hoverYearIdx].NAC, 'Latin America & Caribbean': data('years')[hoverYearIdx].LCN, 'South Asia': data('years')[hoverYearIdx].SAS, 'Sub-Saharan Africa': data('years')[hoverYearIdx].SSF, 'East Asia & Pacific': data('years')[hoverYearIdx].EAS}))
